Gate real USBFS host-state syscall entry in two disposable x86_64 guests. Only
the guest-root tracer pauses the ordinary server's matching blocking TID. No
host USB, ptrace, module, TAP, listener or network configuration is used. This
proves syscall-entry ordering, not an in-kernel active USB ioctl window.
